verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a collaboration and file-sharing platform, but the evidence pack never documents external sharing controls, domain allowlists, or link restrictions. The only related item is Graph API read-write access to tenant-level SharePointSettings, which is a developer building block and does not show sharing governance. A community note about sharing via Active Directory groups concerns internal sharing, not governing external collaboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions
